{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute overall mean flipper length by species (aggregated across all islands)
overall_means = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()
print('Overall mean flipper length by species:')
print(overall_means)

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_species = overall_means.loc[overall_means['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax()]
print(f'\nSpecies with highest overall mean flipper length: {highest_species['species']} ({highest_species['flipper_length_mm']:.2f} mm)')"}
